title: Windows 11 adds simpler toggle for Sticky Keys pop-up
excerpt: Microsoft is updating Windows 11 with a direct checkbox option to disable the recurring Sticky Keys notification prompt.
body_html:
Microsoft is rolling out a minor yet helpful usability adjustment to Windows 11. The operating system is introducing a straightforward checkbox designed to eliminate the frequent Sticky Keys pop-up window.

Previously, managing this accessibility feature often required navigating through several menus or dealing with the persistent prompts triggered by repeated key presses. The new update simplifies this process by providing a direct way to turn off the alert.

The change aims to streamline user experience for those who do not use the Sticky Keys function, removing an unwanted notification that frequently interrupts workflow or gaming sessions.
